limitations: This is an internal agent review within the same project environment. It is not external peer review, independent human domain review, scientific certification, or a new model experiment.

Historical execution facts are assessed against retained records and available source identities. No operating-system event chronology, authentic first-attempt history, remote authenticity, or original model runtime has been independently established.

The four new public programs were executed. The complete historical contract/reader/consumer suites, three-book reconstruction, local upstream integration, private editorial trace and native-model experiments were not rerun.

For aggregated reports without every underlying observation, this review confirms consistency of the retained report and manuscript, not all original observations. The 19305 field checks, 102 consumer executions, and semantic agent ratings remain retained observations.

The three source-book PDFs, all image bytes, complete OCR corpus and full human ground truth were not available or re-examined in this review. OCR accuracy, description truth, uncertainty calibration, and current domain applicability were not evaluated.

The redistribution screen combines prose inspection, evidence-file inventory, and a normalized twelve-word overlap scan against the locally available editorial book OCR. It found no such copied passage; it is not a comprehensive legal clearance or an exact-text comparison with all three historical source books.
Hash equality establishes byte identity under the stated digest assumption; it does not authenticate authors, establish source truth, grant authority, or prove historical chronology.

The review does not approve publication policy admission, deployment, backend indexing, or production readiness. validation-report.json is excluded as assembly metadata being regenerated by the integrator.
